note: One beat per part (TREATMENT.md). Links read the film as cause and effect: the vanish causes every later scene; the boy born at 23:59 is the thread.

beats.name: Countdown
beats.want: a dad wants the new year with his daughter, hand in hand
beats.obstacle: at ONE every woman and girl vanishes

beats.name: Nursery
beats.because: the women are gone, so the nurses and mothers are gone from the nursery
beats.want: a doctor wants to keep the newborns alive alone
beats.obstacle: half the cradles are empty, alarms, no nurses
beats.outcome: he finds the boy born at 23:59 and holds him

beats.name: Care home
beats.because: the carers were women, so the old are left with one man
beats.want: an old man wants tea with his wife
beats.obstacle: her chair is empty; one carer for four trays

beats.name: Lantern
beats.because: every family lost its women, so they mourn
beats.want: a father and son want to say goodbye
beats.obstacle: nobody to bury, only a lantern
beats.outcome: they let it go into a sky of lanterns

beats.name: Office
beats.because: grief does not stop the world needing work, but 4 in 10 workers are gone
beats.want: one man wants to keep the office running

beats.name: Shop
beats.because: with half the workers gone the shelves empty, so men fight
beats.want: two fathers want the last tin
beats.outcome: one lets go for the other's baby

beats.name: Kitchen
beats.because: the care work women did is now all on the fathers
beats.want: a father wants the baby to sleep
beats.outcome: he sleeps; his son covers them

beats.name: Lab
beats.because: the only way on is science, but no one has built a womb
beats.want: scientists want one heartbeat in a glass womb

beats.name: Birthday
beats.because: no births ever again, so the youngest only grow old

beats.name: The last man
beats.human: She held him for one minute
beats.because: the boy born at 23:59 outlives everyone
beats.want: the last man wants to remember her
beats.outcome: the photo of his mother; peace

plants.what: the boy born at 11:59 p.m., one minute before
